title: Ping-Pong vs. AI Robot Showdown
summary: Pong-Bot 3000 vs the ladies. Biscuit steals the ball. The robot does not want to be turned off. Justine: “If we lose, I'm buying the robot a latte.”
visualArc: Neon café → glowing ball trail → Biscuit on the table → USB heart toss.
